package.name: Smooth
package.description:
Synchronize FreeCAD's CAM tool libraries with a Smooth tool data server.
Adds a "Sync with Smooth" button to the CAM workbench toolbar and a preference page for server configuration.
Current capabilities (v2 rework in progress): - Export tool bits and libraries to the server, losslessly; re-export updates in place (never duplicates) - Exported files carry their server identity; unknown keys (e.g. F&S presets) survive round trips untouched - Import (server to FreeCAD) arrives with the next milestone
Requirements: - FreeCAD 1.1 or later with the CAM workbench - A Smooth server (self-hosted or hosted) - see https://loobric.com - Standard library only: no extra Python packages
